datasets.name: Japan_hokkaido landslide dataset
datasets.source: Authors' own collection and manual digitization
datasets.verbatim: In this study, we collect and process the high-resolution remote sensing data of Japan_Hokkaido... Finally, we manually digitize landslides based on Planet Scope imagery to validate the model’s effectiveness.

datasets.name: Planet Scope surface reflectance imagery
datasets.verbatim: Images used in multitemporal landslide inventory mapping are from Planet Scope surface reflectance with a spatial resolution of 3 m.

datasets.name: Jiuzhaigou, Sichuan Province, China landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: To further demonstrate the scalability of the proposed PluTsa method, experiments are conducted on another multitemporal high-resolution remote sensing image dataset in Jiuzhaigou, Sichuan Province, China

methods.name: progressive label upgradation and cross-temporal style adaption (PluTsa)
methods.summary: PluTsa is an unsupervised multitemporal landslide detection framework. It uses a U-Net segmentation network and incorporates three core components: a transformer-based cross-temporal style adaptation strategy to reduce interdomain visual differences, a temporal-aware pairing constraint (tpc) to align feature distributions, and a progressive label upgradation (PLU) scheme to generate high-quality pseudolabels for intradomain adaptation.
methods.source: Penglei Li, Yi Wang, Guanting Liu, Zhice Fang, and Kashif Ullah
methods.verbatim: we propose a novel method called progressive label upgradation and cross-temporal style adaption (PluTsa) for unsupervised multitemporal landslide detection.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are not linked or referenced, and the custom code for the PluTsa method is not provided via any repository or persistent link.
